introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our websites, dashboards, Discord bots, APIs, CDN, and desktop applications.

account.title: Account & Device Session Information:
account.desc: When you sign in via Discord OAuth2 or our QR Code / 6-character Pairing Code Device Sign-In flow, we collect your Discord ID, username, avatar, email address, custom profile settings (display name, bio, pronouns, banner), and recent device session metadata (browser, operating system, device type, and last-active timestamp for up to 10 devices) so you can review and manage active sessions.

connections.title: Connected Third-Party Accounts:
connections.desc: If you optionally link external accounts (such as GitHub, Twitch, YouTube, X/Twitter, Spotify, Steam, or Reddit) in Account Settings, we store the public account identifier, username, display name, avatar URL, profile URL, and your visibility preference ("Show on Public Profile"). We immediately discard OAuth access tokens after verifying your identity.

developers.title: For API & Bot Developers:
developers.desc: Scoped Bearer API tokens, webhook URLs, application and organization metadata, real-time WebSocket gateway telemetry, and configuration settings used to operate your integrations on our infrastructure.

botUsers.title: For Bot & Community End Users:
botUsers.desc: When you interact with a bot powered by Xernerx (such as Virtue, Zodiac, Metamorphosis, or To-Do List Bot), we process your Discord ID, guild IDs, command inputs, and opt-in community engagement metrics (such as text and voice XP/leveling statistics). We do not store raw message logs unless explicitly required by an opt-in server feature.

cdnAndContent.title: CDN Media & Community Submissions:
cdnAndContent.desc: Files and images uploaded to cdn.xernerx.com or attached to bug reports and feature suggestions are stored in private cloud blob storage and served according to your configured visibility setting (public, limited to specific users, or private).

desktop.title: Xernerx Desktop Client:
desktop.desc: When using the Xernerx Desktop App, window state, update channel preferences (Stable/Canary), hotkey bindings, and isolated multi-account session slots are stored locally on your machine. If enabled, the app communicates locally with your Discord client for Rich Presence (RPC) and writes diagnostic logs locally only when Debug Logging is turned on.

usage.title: Usage & Diagnostic Data:
usage.desc: Error logs, security audit trails, and system interactions collected to maintain platform stability, enforce rate limits, and prevent abuse.

integration.title: Billing, Store & Rewards Data:
integration.desc: Subscription status, billing history, and regional checkout details processed securely via Stripe (we never store raw payment card numbers), along with platform Virtual Credit balances and daily mystery gift streak timestamps.

apiData.title: 3. API Data Collection & Developer Obligations
apiData.content: When developers use our REST API (/v1/* and /secure/*), embeddable public widgets, or real-time WebSocket gateway to synchronize bot statistics or fetch metadata, we collect and store this data to render public pages and provide analytics. Developers are strictly prohibited from transmitting unrequested personally identifiable information (PII) of their end users to our API. We do not sell or share API data with third-party advertisers.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process personal data based on contractual necessity (to deliver the services and subscriptions you request), legitimate interests (security, fraud prevention, and service improvement), compliance with legal obligations, or your explicit consent where applicable.

usage.title: 5. How We Use Information
items: To provide, authenticate, and synchronize your account across all Xernerx web applications, bots, and desktop clients.
To process Store subscriptions, allocate Virtual Credits, enforce CDN storage quotas, and improve platform reliability.

To provide customer support, communicate platform updates, and send important service-related emails (e.g., billing receipts, security alerts, and organization invitations). You may manage your notification preferences at any time.
To detect abuse, enforce our Terms of Service, and comply with applicable legal obligations.

sharing.title: 6. Data Sharing
items: Cloud hosting, database, and private blob storage infrastructure providers.
Payment processors (Stripe) for subscription checkout, Adaptive Pricing localization, and billing management.
Authorized third-party integrations and connected accounts that you explicitly link or enable as public profile widgets.
Law enforcement or regulatory authorities when strictly required by applicable law.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, unless longer retention is required by law (such as tax and accounting records). Ephemeral QR/pairing sign-in tickets automatically expire after 3 minutes.

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.content: We implement robust technical and organizational security measures, including AES-256-GCM encryption for cross-device sign-in tokens, HTTP-only session cookies, scoped Bearer token authentication, and strict role-based access controls. However, no internet transmission or storage system is 100% secure.

rights.title: 9. Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA)
items: Right to access and export your personal data (available any time via the self-service "Export Data (JSON)" tool in Account -> Activity).
Right to rectification, profile reset, or permanent account deletion (available directly in Account -> Settings).
Right to restrict or object to certain data processing activities and to unlink connected third-party accounts at any time.
Right to withdraw consent for non-essential cookies and marketing communications.
rights.content: Under data protection frameworks including the GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, you have comprehensive rights over your personal data. You can exercise most of these rights instantly through your Account Dashboard or by contacting our legal team.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and local storage to keep your session secure across *.xernerx.com subdomains, remember your theme and workspace preferences, and measure site performance. Third-party services such as Google AdSense may also use cookies to serve relevant advertisements based on your consent. For a complete breakdown of every cookie we set and how to manage your preferences, please read our

international.title: 11. International Transfers
international.content: If personal data is transferred outside your jurisdiction (including outside the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom), we implement appropriate legal and technical safeguards to ensure your data remains protected.

childrensPrivacy.title: 12. Children's Privacy (COPPA)
childrensPrivacy.content: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the minimum digital consent age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us so we can promptly delete it.

changes.title: 13. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. When material changes occur, we update the policy version timestamp and prompt authenticated users to review and accept the revised policy.

contact.title: 14. Contact
contact.prefix: For privacy-related inquiries or data requests, contact

eligibility.content: You must be at least 13 years of age (or the minimum age of digital consent in your jurisdiction) to use our services. By using our services, you represent and warrant that you satisfy this requirement and comply with Discord's Terms of Service.

Attempt to access accounts, private CDN blobs, API endpoints, or administrative tools without explicit authorization.

apiUsage.title: 4. API, Widgets & WebSocket Gateway Terms
apiUsage.content: Developers using our REST API (/v1/* and /secure/*), embeddable public widgets, or real-time WebSocket RPC gateway must adhere to the following rules:
items: Respect all rate limits and plan quotas; do not spam, scrape, or abuse API endpoints or WebSocket connections.
You are solely responsible for securing your Bearer API tokens; we are not liable for unauthorized actions caused by leaked keys.
Telemetry, command registries, and statistics submitted to the platform must be accurate and never artificially inflated.
We reserve the right to immediately revoke API tokens, disable public widgets, or suspend applications that degrade platform stability or violate these Terms.

botUsage.title: 5. Bot End User Terms
botUsage.content: Users interacting with Xernerx-powered Discord bots (including Virtue, Metamorphosis, Zodiac, and To-Do List Bot) agree not to exploit command inputs, automate abusive requests, or harass other community members. Server owners and administrators are responsible for configuring bot modules in compliance with both these Terms and Discord's Terms of Service.

accounts.title: 6. User Accounts, QR Sign-In & Connected Accounts
accounts.content: You authenticate via Discord OAuth2 or our encrypted QR Code / Pairing Code Device Sign-In system. Never approve a QR code or enter a 6-character pairing code that you did not initiate yourself. You may also optionally link third-party accounts (such as GitHub, Twitch, YouTube, X/Twitter, Spotify, Steam, or Reddit) to display on your public profile. You are responsible for all activity occurring under your account and can revoke active device sessions or unlink connected accounts at any time in Account Settings.

storeAndBilling.title: 7. Store, Subscriptions & Virtual Credits
storeAndBilling.content: Paid subscriptions (including the Xernerx Ultra bundle, Individual Bot Passes, Server Infrastructure Passes, and Developer API Pro) and add-ons are billed in advance on a recurring monthly or annual cycle via Stripe, which may display localized currencies through Stripe Adaptive Pricing:
items: You may cancel a recurring subscription at any time via the Billing Portal; your plan benefits remain active until the end of the current paid billing period.

Virtual Credits, Daily Mystery Gifts, and login streak rewards are non-monetary digital platform features with no real-world cash value. They cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred between users, or refunded outside mandatory statutory consumer rights.

If a subscription downgrades or expires, features and CDN storage quotas revert to standard tier limits; existing files are not immediately deleted without notice, but new uploads may be restricted if you exceed your active quota.

desktopClient.title: 8. Xernerx Desktop Client
desktopClient.content: We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to download and use the Xernerx Desktop application for personal or internal community management use. The Desktop client may automatically download and install updates (across Stable or Canary release channels), register optional global keyboard shortcuts, display a floating mini overlay, maintain isolated multi-account sessions, and communicate locally with Discord for Rich Presence.

availability.title: 10. Service Availability
availability.content: We strive for high availability across our suite, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. Features, bot modules, APIs, or experimental Canary builds may be modified, suspended, or discontinued at any time.

thirdParty.title: 11. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our ecosystem integrates with third-party platforms including Discord, Stripe, Google (for translation and advertising services), and optional connected account providers (GitHub, Twitch, YouTube, X/Twitter, Spotify, Steam, and Reddit). We are not responsible for the availability, policies, or independent practices of third-party services.

intellectualProperty.title: 12. Intellectual Property & User Content
intellectualProperty.content: All Xernerx software, source code (excluding open-source packages licensed under their respective repository licenses), branding, and visual assets remain the exclusive property of Xernerx Studios. You retain ownership of media and content you upload to cdn.xernerx.com or submit to our platform, and grant Xernerx Studios a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to host, cache, and deliver that content solely according to the visibility permissions (public, limited, or private) you configure.

warranty.title: 13. Disclaimer of Warranties
warranty.content: Services are provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, whether express, implied, or statutory, including implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement.

liability.content: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Xernerx Studios shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of data, revenue, or profits arising from your use of our services.

indemnification.title: 15. Indemnification
indemnification.content: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Xernerx Studios and its team members from any claims, damages, or liabilities arising out of your misuse of our services, your uploaded content, your developer applications, or your violation of these Terms.

governingLaw.title: 16. Governing Law

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Cookie Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", or "us") uses cookies, local storage, session partitions, and similar technologies when you visit or interact with our websites, dashboards, APIs, and desktop applications.

whatAreCookies.title: 2. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your web browser when you visit a website. They allow the platform to recognize your device, maintain your authenticated session seamlessly across all Xernerx subdomains (*.xernerx.com), and remember your customized interface preferences.

essential.title: Essential Cookies:
essential.desc: Strictly necessary for the core operation and security of our services. These include Discord OAuth2 authentication sessions, CSRF protection, secondary account-linking state verification, and your saved cookie consent state. Because the platform cannot function securely without them, they cannot be disabled.

functional.title: Functional Cookies:
functional.desc: Used to remember your personal preferences across subdomains, including your selected language, interface theme (dark, light, or system), accent color, layout density, UI zoom, typography scale, and header/sidebar workspace toggles.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies:
analytics.desc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our websites, monitor platform performance, and diagnose technical errors so we can improve reliability.

marketing.title: Marketing & Advertising Cookies:
marketing.desc: Used by third-party advertising partners (such as Google AdSense) to deliver relevant advertisements and measure campaign effectiveness.

cookiesUsed.title: 4. Specific Cookies We Set
cookiesUsed.content: Across the Xernerx ecosystem (.xernerx.com), we set and read the following first-party cookies:

auth.title: Authentication & OAuth State (__Secure-next-auth.session-token, __Secure-next-auth.csrf-token, __Secure-next-auth.callback-url, __Secure-next-auth.state, __xernerx_conn_oauth):
auth.desc: Essential HTTP-only secure cookies managed by NextAuth to authenticate your session across subdomains, prevent cross-site request forgery, and verify short-lived (10-minute) PKCE/OAuth state when linking third-party accounts on account.xernerx.com.

consent.title: Cookie Consent (xernerx-cookie-consent):
consent.desc: An essential cookie that stores your chosen cookie category preferences (essential, functional, analytics, marketing) and an agreedAt timestamp for up to 1 year. If we publish a material update to this Cookie Policy, the agreedAt timestamp is compared against the latest policy version so we can re-prompt you.

locale.title: Localization (NEXT_LOCALE):
locale.desc: A functional cookie that remembers your preferred interface language across all Xernerx subdomains for up to 1 year.

appearance.title: Interface, Appearance & Workspace Preferences (theme, accent, uiZoom, uiGap, textScale, clientSync, syncFromDiscord, pref_*):
appearance.desc: Functional cookies (including pref_showHeaderStore, pref_showHeaderCommandPalette, pref_showHeaderNotifications, pref_showHeaderDownload, pref_showHeaderAppDrawer, pref_showShortcutHints, pref_showDiscordCollectibles, pref_showGiftBadge, pref_reducedMotion, pref_defaultSidebarCollapsed, and pref_developerMode) that preserve your visual and workspace customizations so the server can render your layout immediately without visual flickering.

localStorage.title: 5. Local Storage & Desktop Client Storage
localStorage.content: In addition to browser cookies, we use browser localStorage (including theme, accent, uiZoom, uiGap, textScale, pref_*, and xernerx_sidebar_view_* keys) to cache non-sensitive interface state locally for instant startup. In the Xernerx Desktop App (Electron), local configuration is stored in metadata.json and each account slot uses an isolated Chromium session partition (persist:xernerx and persist:xernerx-<slot>) so you can switch between multiple accounts safely.

thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.content: Some features integrate with third-party services, including Discord (for primary authentication), Stripe (for secure checkout, billing portals, and fraud prevention), Google AdSense (for displaying advertisements when consented), and optional connected account providers (GitHub, Twitch, Google/YouTube, X/Twitter, Spotify, Steam, and Reddit) when you initiate account linking. These third parties may set their own cookies in accordance with their respective policies.

managing.title: 7. Managing Your Preferences
managing.content: You can review or update your cookie consent choices at any time by clicking "Cookie Preferences" in the website footer to reopen the preferences manager. You may also configure your web browser to block or delete cookies, though blocking essential cookies will prevent you from signing in or using authenticated features.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our technology, infrastructure, or legal requirements. When updated, we bump our policy version date so visitors are prompted to review their cookie preferences.
